_note: The only text that may reach occupants. Signs and announcements are assembled from these entries; no LLM text is ever sent to the public.

sign.stay: STAY HERE — you are in a safe area
sign.lockdown: LOCKDOWN — go into a lockable room, stay out of sight

announcement.EVACUATE_VIA: Please leave the building now by {route}. Do not use the elevator.
announcement.EVACUATE_VIA_DELAYED: Please stay where you are. You will be told when to leave by {route}.
announcement.HOLD: Please stay where you are and wait for instructions.
announcement.LOCKDOWN: Lockdown. Go into the nearest room that locks, lock the door and stay out of sight.
announcement.MOVE_TO_COMPARTMENT: Please move calmly to {route}. Staff will help anyone who needs it.
